capabilities: Open any markdown file as a kanban board via context menu or command palette
Drag and drop cards within and across columns and reorder columns
Manage tag-based labels with colors and rename propagation
Filter the board into swimlanes by label
Archive columns and toggle card checkboxes inline
extras: README states the plugin was entirely developed with Claude Opus 4.6; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and manipulate a markdown list as a kanban board with columns, cards, and drag-and-drop.
summary: Renders nested markdown lists as interactive kanban boards with drag-and-drop, labels, and swimlanes while keeping files plain text.
